subject: Post-call commitments & rollforward plan — BrightBridge discovery
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@brightbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call commitments & rollforward plan — BrightBridge discovery

Maya — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed rollforward so we keep momentum heading into procurement:

Key pain we heard:
- High per-request latency on the current orchestration for document summarization (~700–900ms p50 to enterprise search).
- Rising token costs when running daily bulk-embedding jobs for vector search; ops wants predictable per-month spend.
- Need for stricter data controls (VPC + customer-managed keys) for compliance with customer contracts.

Business goals you stated:
1) Reduce inference latency to p50 < 250ms for short summarization requests.
2) Get a bounded monthly spend for embeddings for 50M tokens/month during pilot.
3) Ship a secure pilot (VPC + KMS) so legal/procurement can approve the POC.

Proposed pilot milestones (owners & target dates):
- Pilot scope & acceptance criteria (owner: Maya / BrightBridge) — target: 2026-06-30
- Redwood pilot configuration & cost estimate (owner: Neha / Redwood AE) — target: 2026-06-25 (attached: Redwood_Pilot_Budget_Estimate.xlsx)
- Security questionnaire + evidence (owner: Jasmine / Redwood Security) — target: 2026-06-28 (attached: SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf)
- Legal/SOW review & signoff (owner: BrightBridge legal + Redwood legal) — target: 2026-07-09
- Pilot kickoff (engineering ramp + shared tests) — target: 2026-07-12

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Can you confirm the internal stakeholders (legal, procurement contact, and technical owner) we should loop into the SOW sync?
- I’ve attached a one-page rollforward (redwood-pilot-rollforward-20260620.pdf) and a budget estimate — comments welcome.
- Proposed next call: 30-min procurement + legal sync on 2026-06-24 or 2026-06-25. Which works for your team?

Links & artifacts:
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/BB-7890
- Draft rollforward (Drive): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cRedwoodMPA

If that matches your read, I’ll loop in TechOps and our Security PO to start the questionnaire. Thanks — excited to get this into a pilot.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: Redwood_Pilot_Budget_Estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-pilot-rollforward-20260620.pdf (1-page summary), SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf (summary)
From: Maya Patel <maya@brightbridge.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, procurement@brightbridge.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call commitments & rollforward plan — BrightBridge discovery

Thanks Neha — useful recap. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Procurement timeline: we have a monthly procurement board that reviews POC spend and vendor contracts. Target for vendor approvals is the week of 2026-07-05; legal will need a draft SOW and an initial pricing band before that meeting.
- Technical owner: I’ll own integration validation (Maya). The engineering lead is Arjun Nair (arjun@brightbridge.ai) — please loop him into the kickoff invites.
- Security: procurement asked for a short SOC2 summary plus whether Redwood can support a VPC peering option and customer-managed KMS. Jasmine — would appreciate the SOC2 artifact you mentioned.

On dates — 2026-06-25 works for a short procurement sync for us (afternoon ET). Please send a calendar invite and include Arjun + our legal (legal@brightbridge.ai).

On the rollforward: looks reasonable at a high level. A couple of follow-ups I’ll raise internally — mainly around committed monthly token caps and who owns overage. We prefer a soft cap with a notification threshold before charges.

Thanks — I’ll confirm internal attendees and add Arjun to the thread later today.

Best,
Maya
Head of Product
BrightBridge AI
maya@brightbridge.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@brightbridge.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 12:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call commitments & rollforward plan — BrightBridge discovery

Maya / Neha — quick technical note from my side:

- For the latency target (p50 < 250ms) we recommend a small dedicated pool (1x A10G equivalent) during the pilot with prefix/KV caching enabled for summaries; we can load test against your 5k daily reqs to validate.
- For embeddings cost cap: we can set a billing alert and a soft quota on token consumption. Neha — I’ll prepare a quick cost sensitivity table and include it in the budget spreadsheet by end of day tomorrow.

Arjun — happy to pair on the load-test script and the endpoint config.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
